messages:
Nina: Heads up - our monthly showback shows ~ $27k of reserved GPU spend sitting as 'unattributed' in the shared-pool. That skews team budgets. Can someone dig into attribution rules?
BillingBot: Alert: Reserved-instance mismatch detected. resource=shared-gpu-pool, unattributed_cost=$26,978, ticket FIN-10188 created.
Carlos: Investigating. Quick query shows many reservations have label `reservation_owner=ops` but downstream compute labels are `team=na` because booking flow doesn't propagate labels when tenants claim slots.
Priyanka: Hmm. Two problems: (1) revenue/showback mapping expects compute.jobs to carry `reservation_id` or `team` label, (2) billing export groups reservations separately. We can either backfill attribution via reservation usage logs or change the booking flow to enforce labels.
Nina: Ops prefers backfill for Jan-Mar so we don't reclass historic invoices, but dev teams want future traffic labeled cleanly.
Carlos: I can produce a backfill mapping using `reservation_usage` table: `SELECT reservation_id, usage_seconds, attached_project FROM reservation_usage WHERE month='2026-02'` then join to projects to assign team based on owner mapping. Will take ~2 hours.
AR-Liz: For AR and customer invoices we need clarity: any customer-facing demos billed from this pool must be invoiced separately. Do we have records to split internal vs customer usage?
OpsBot: Note: recent booking PR #4332 enforces `owner_team` and `billing_ticket` annotations at allocation time. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4332
Priyanka: Finance preference: backfill showback for closed months, and enforce label policy for future months. For backfill GL treatment, mark as internal allocation for infra GL 6102, and invoice customers separately where usage maps to a customer id.
Nina: Carlos please run the backfill and drop a CSV to /finance/gpu-transfers/1940001122-shared-pool-backfill.csv and tag FIN-10188. Also include list of customer-project ids for AR.
Carlos: Will do. Also will add a nightly audit to compare reservation_owner vs compute team label and alert if mismatch > 2% :white_check_mark:.
BillingBot: FIN-10188 updated: status=awaiting_backfill. Reminder: automated tag-backfill can be run but needs ops approval.
AR-Liz: Once we have the CSV I'll prepare any invoice adjustments. If customers were billed already, we'll credit and reissue.
Priyanka: After backfill, finance will post reclassification journals and update showback. Please ensure audit trail: reservation logs, CSV, PR link, approver emails.
Nina: Thanks — please keep this thread for audit record. Leaving notes and moving to FIN-10188. :thumbsup:
